Three equal panels: straight front, left three-quarter 45 degrees, right profile 90 degrees. Each panel shows the SAME woman from the top of her head to mid-chest at the same scale. Soft neutral broad studio lighting, gray seamless background, no hard neck shadow, no makeup retouch, no beauty stylization. Show a continuous natural skin tone from cheeks to jaw to neck to the base of the throat, with mild real local color variation and fine pores. Hair is gathered naturally, not a helmet or floating painted wisps. Preserve original facial features, age, uniform colors, no new accessories or badges. This is a reference for repairing the existing 3D model, not a redesign. No text, no annotations.
